'''Sprawl 34''' was a floating ranch located in the northwest quadrant of the planet [[Tyed Kant]]. It was the headquarters of [[Premier Provisions]], a front company for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

A group of Rebel agents heading to Sprawl 34 during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] were routed to [[Sprawl 41]] instead, as Sprawl 34 had become infected with the [[Mynock virus]]. Everyone on board Sprawl 34 was asphyxiated when the Mynock virus caused the computer systems to malfunction. Eventually the virus caused the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] to fail, and the entire platform fell into the depths of the planet to be crushed.<ref name="MC" />
